speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The whole tragedy, in apparel, and then we stop. The stage is rimed. The brazier stays in the tiring-house. Nick, under the note from the first entrance. We are not buying a second courage.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can hold it if I come in under the note, sir. The cold helps. It keeps me down. I am not going to show you what I feel.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He comes through the cold like a bell under water. Leave him there. I am not taking my eyes off him. Look at me when the height frightens you, Nick. Not at the gallery.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And the Nurse. I can stop a yard if I spend her. How much of Saturday am I to keep in my pocket?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave something for Saturday, Thomas. If the yard has the whole Nurse this morning, Saturday is a second helping. You may be funny where the part is funny. You may not empty it to prove you can.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then I keep a silence I have not been paid to admire. I have heard you. Wednesday does not get the last of her.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is on the peg. I am timing the apparel, not the argument. Arguments are not in the glass.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Time it, Abel. The court is to be two hours and a half, and that cut is another paper. Today I want the length of what we have, frost and all. The vault next. The tiring-house door for a mouth. The trestle for a bier. No one is to be clever with a property.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: The door is a mouth. The bier is a trestle. I will lie on it. I am still not discussing the doublet.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: By the fifth act on Saturday it will be dusk in earnest. I want to know when the torches live. I will not invent a sunset by talking.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then light them when he says light, and not before. The word is the cue. The galleries are not to be a general fire because a tireman was cold.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I have it as the boy's entrance. The cressets are up before he speaks. The speech finds the light already there. That is how I heard you, and a book cannot keep two mornings.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I heard my word. They wait in the dark, and the fire comes in when I say light. Not before. I will not have a sunset that begins without me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I said not before. I did not say which hearing we keep. Both of you heard a true thing. Two cues for one word is a fault in the playing. Thursday's copy will keep one. I will not choose it in this frost with the ink still wet.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Both in the margin, then, and no circle. The glass will tell the length, and I will say the length once.

speaker: james_burbage
text: There's a great stone hall in the Blackfriars would hold a winter. I only say there is one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I hear you, Master Burbage. I do not hear a price. We are in the middle of a death.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Father. Not over his bier. He has a boy on a trestle. The hall will keep.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I have not come to sell a winter. Two cloaks, a sentence, and the yard is where I was standing. The hall is a thing I have seen.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Raye had it off a book, not off a stage. By Henslowe's book, Monday was the thirty-first of November. Thou seest, Will? There's a man keeps the calendar we're to be paid by.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not go and look at that book, and I will not be paid by it. The fan is still for Saturday, Will. Do not spend a calendar as if it were a jig.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am showing it to thee, which is cheaper. A man who can find a thirty-first in November can find a shilling that is not there. I am glad he is not on our side of the river.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Two hours and fifty minutes. I have it by the glass, and I say it once. The court cut is another paper. This is the apparel, frost included.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two hours and fifty. Write it under the plot. Thomas, something remains for Saturday. Nick, under, as you were. Dick, the word is light, and not before. I am not choosing the hearing today.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Under. I will obey the one you keep. Until you keep it I will lie still and come in low.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Something remains. I have not done the last of her. You may thank me on Saturday if you remember men on Saturdays.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Five words at the end of it, which are still not a speech. I can die on them. I do not yet like them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You can dislike them and still die on them when the day comes. Today you have died on a trestle, which is enough dying for a Wednesday. Two Gentlemen can have the afternoon. I am not in it.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Good. The hall will not run away, and I will not make it cost anything by adding a figure. I only say there is one.

speaker: will_kemp
text: And I will not pretend on Saturday that I heard two hours. I heard two hours and fifty. The thirty-first can stay in the other man's book.
